## The decay curve

A contact map falls off with distance:

```{r}
s <- 10^(3:7)
data.frame(s = s, p = contact_decay(s))
```

```{r, fig.alt = "The decay curve on a log scale"}
plot(s, contact_decay(s), log = "xy", type = "b")
```

### A table

| Distance | Frequency |
|---:|---:|
| 1 kb | 1e-3 |
| 1 Mb | 1e-6 |
